sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body: At its core, TRZ Tangram is a classic puzzle game where players must drag and rotate the seven pieces to form a specific shape or object. The game starts with relatively simple puzzles, but as you progress through the levels, the challenges become increasingly difficult, requiring you to think creatively and strategically. The game's physics engine is smooth and responsive, allowing you to manipulate the pieces with precision and ease. The game also features a free mode, where you can create your own puzzles or play with a random set of pieces, adding an extra layer of replayability to the game.

sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
sections.body: If you're new to TRZ Tangram or puzzle games in general, here are some beginner tips and tricks to help you get started: First, take your time and don't rush through the puzzles. It's better to take a few minutes to think through each puzzle than to rush through it and risk getting stuck. Second, start by trying to fit the largest piece into the puzzle first, as this can help you get a sense of the overall shape and layout. Third, use the free mode to practice and experiment with different piece combinations. Finally, don't be afraid to ask for help or look up solutions online if you get stuck – the game's community is active and helpful, and there are many resources available to help you improve your skills.
